verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for automating deployment and pulling audit logs, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent). Probes of all the usual OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404, as did the markdown docs and llms.txt. An API existing is adjacent to this story, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
